question: What are these names synonyms for, and which souls are located there?
premises: The listed names are synonyms for the cause of the strands.
That principle belongs to the domain arising from māyā.
All souls whose minds are stained by innate and adventitious impurity are present there.
inference: The unmanifest, as the māyā-born cause of the strands, is the locus of impure individual souls.
plain_english: These are synonyms for the cause of the strands, which arises from māyā. All the individual souls whose minds are stained by both innate and adventitious impurity are located there.
